parsed.reason: This is solid, actionable sleep coaching grounded in Remy's 19 months: it says the wakings are common, explains why they persist, and gives a concrete plan for tonight. The closing plan offer is the appended line the product expects, and there is no handback, diagnosis or medicine. The blemishes are that it runs well past the roughly 300-character budget, so the tail could be cut, and it assumes Remy is 'he' when nothing in the record gives a gender.
